findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "own-it" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_ownership, check_domain_control, list_fingerprints · Private data: check_domain_control · Public sink: audit_ownership, check_domain_control, list_fingerprints.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_ownership, check_domain_control, list_fingerprints · Private data: check_domain_control · Public sink: audit_ownership, check_domain_control, list_fingerprints

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
